topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: It turns out, the person I've been chatting with for months lives just a few blocks away. I can't decide if the universe is cruel or kind. We've shared so much online, but now it feels like everything I know about this person might be in my head. Typing on a screen is one thing, but the idea of actually meeting them here, in the real world, makes my fingers fumble on the keyboard. What if there's an awkward pause, a mismatch in the way we thought we understood each other? I wonder if I should reach out, suggest a meet-up, or if it’s better to just keep it online, where it’s safe. Maybe I’ll wait a day, give myself some time to sort through this.
